items.why: VIX falling as the market steadies after a volatile week. Yahoo Finance has the Dow, S&P 500 and Nasdaq mixed, while Kiplinger notes stocks churned higher even as tech got chipped.

Sliding with chip peers after Nvidia unveiled a new PC processor competing with AMD's x86 chips, on top of the week's $1T AI selloff driven by rate and AI funding worries, per TipRanks and TradingKey.
Still digesting Goldman Sachs' price target cut to $762 from $860 on October 14, driven by concerns that heavy AI spending pressures 2027 operating expenses.
No single headline; moving with the broader tape.

market_note: Nasdaq futures off about 0.8% while the Dow future is higher; the tape is mixed.
summary: Stocks are mixed after a volatile week. Tech is under pressure from renewed doubts about AI spending and financing costs, while blue chips and gold hold steadier.
